title: Luke's visit down the Osiris shaft

tellings.quote: I was with Land of Kim and he showed me if you're familiar with him. And um so you go down in the Osiris shaft and it drops down.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns says he went down the Osiris shaft, a deep shaft cut into the rock under the causeway leading to the pyramids at Giza, and that "it drops down" into the depths. He tells Michels he made the visit himself, guided by someone known as Land of Kem, whom Caverns expects Michels may know. He shares it as a first-hand look at one of the sites he thinks shows the pyramids are not what we think.
